scope: Isolated PostgreSQL schema and private FetchSandbox HubSpot Contacts / Resend single-send fixtures. No live CRM, real email, model or money.

checks.name: crm: exact approval, execute and authoritative read-back
checks.detail: Real LoopLabs service -> HTTP -> existing FetchSandbox engine -> persisted provider state.

checks.name: crm: replay sends no second effect
checks.detail: Compare provider effect journal before and after action replay.

checks.name: crm: response lost after effect, reconcile without resend
checks.detail: Twin writes and persists then delays response; 1.5s adapter timeout.

checks.name: crm: restart preserves effect and prevents duplicate replay
checks.detail: Restart the actual twin process; replay returns existing effect.

checks.name: crm: later write produces conflict
checks.detail: Distinct fixture record versions reveal intervening writes; live HubSpot CAS not claimed.

checks.name: email: exact approval, execute and authoritative read-back
checks.detail: Real LoopLabs service -> HTTP -> existing FetchSandbox engine -> persisted provider state.

checks.name: email: replay sends no second effect
checks.detail: Compare provider effect journal before and after action replay.

checks.name: email: response lost after effect, reconcile without resend
checks.detail: Twin writes and persists then delays response; 1.5s adapter timeout.

checks.name: email: restart preserves effect and prevents duplicate replay
checks.detail: Restart the actual twin process; replay returns existing effect.

checks.name: provider rejects unauthorized requests
checks.detail: No provider credential is given to agents.

checks.name: provider rejects recipient and template escape
checks.detail: Only the prepared sample recipient and exact message are allowed.

checks.name: provider 401: retain uncertainty, never blind retry
checks.detail: Actual HTTP rejection; absence is not proof that an arbitrary real provider cannot complete.

checks.name: provider 429: retain uncertainty, never blind retry
checks.detail: Actual HTTP rejection; absence is not proof that an arbitrary real provider cannot complete.

checks.name: provider 500: retain uncertainty, never blind retry
checks.detail: Actual HTTP rejection; absence is not proof that an arbitrary real provider cannot complete.

checks.name: crm: stale approved source cannot overwrite a later update
checks.detail: The fixture enforces an exact source version at write time. This CAS extension is not a live HubSpot feature claim.

checks.name: worker SIGKILL before effect
checks.detail: Terminate a real worker process; lease expiry injected in isolated test schema. Before-effect absence remains uncertain, never automatically retried.

checks.name: worker SIGKILL after effect
checks.detail: Terminate a real worker process; lease expiry injected in isolated test schema. Before-effect absence remains uncertain, never automatically retried.

checks.name: workflow: external agents submit scoped steps through actual HTTP handlers
checks.detail: Separate Node agent processes use only scoped keys. Provider credentials stay in the server harness.

checks.name: workflow: fresh action IDs cannot escape enrolled agent boundaries
checks.detail: Enrollment restricts these agent identities to immutable workflow step IDs, not merely the dashboard path.

checks.name: workflow: downstream API cannot bypass a missing predecessor
checks.detail: The dependency guard is enforced in the shared action execution service, not only in the dashboard.

checks.name: workflow: lost upstream response holds downstream execution
checks.detail: Actual twin write completes before its response is delayed; the message stays undispatched.

checks.name: workflow: API process termination preserves run and proposals
checks.detail: Terminate the actual HTTP handler process with SIGKILL, restart it and replay the external agent submission.

checks.name: workflow: reconciliation unlocks the downstream step without resending upstream
checks.detail: Third step reads both twin outcomes; there are two intended effects and no automatic upstream resend.

checks.name: workflow: stale CRM approval cannot release the downstream message
checks.detail: The actual twin rejects a stale approved CRM source version and the dependent message remains undispatched.

checks.name: workflow: provider bypass without its private credential is rejected
checks.detail: A LoopLabs agent key is not a provider credential. This is fixture enforcement, not a customer network audit.

checks.name: enquiry: saved plan, independent approvals, lost response and restart through HTTP
checks.detail: Real PostgreSQL and FetchSandbox HTTP. A reviewed sample enquiry survives API restart; response loss is reconciled without resending and the acknowledgement stays held until its predecessor is verified. No real delivery or model is used.

checks.name: isolated database backup and restore preserves actions and evidence
checks.detail: Actual pg_dump/pg_restore in a dedicated test schema. This is a local drill, not production PITR, host failover or an availability SLA.

limits: Fixture action journal and contact version are LoopLabs extensions, not live provider parity.
No SSO, failover, production load or real delivery proof.
Only one sample contact and one fixed message template/recipient.
